text:
Rina Shah: Quick proposal 1-day PLG experiment: combine modest free credits + curated prompt templates + a short follow-up webinar as an activation nudge. Target: +10% conversion to active usage in 7 days.

Diego Morales: Like it. Suggest 3 arms: control, $8 credit + generic onboarding, $20 credit + prompt-pack. Keep cohorts ~800 each.

Tara Wu: Prompt-pack should be 4 bite-sized templates (search, support reply, short marketing blurb, semantic rerank). Each with 2 examples and recommended temp. I'll draft.

Rina Shah: Good. Also want an in-app checklist card that the user can check off after they run their first generation. That becomes our time_to_first_success metric.

Diego Morales: Measurement: events = marketing.plg.signup, marketing.plg.credit_awarded, marketing.plg.credit_redeemed, marketing.plg.first_generate, marketing.plg.retention_7d. Routing: if redeem AND embedding_calls >4 -> create HubSpot lead tag "plg-activated".

ops-bot: Note: ensure HubSpot API rate limits handled. Recommend batching creates every 5 min.

Tara Wu: Timeline: prompts by Tue EOD. design will need gallery art for the template card. I'll add quick usage notes.

Rina Shah: Webinar idea : "From prompts to product: getting useful outputs from open models". 25-min live demo + q&a in week 2. Invite only to credit redeemers; attendees get $7 bonus credit.

Diego Morales: Good incentive. Add registration UTMs and pass experiment_variant so we can attribute attendance lifts. Also, schedule an automated follow-up email with a recording for non-attendees.

Tara Wu: Small ask: can we include a micro task in the onboarding card: "Generate a product search result for XYZ" so we standardize success criteria? That'll help compare arms.

Rina Shah: Agreed. Next: Diego -> implement tracking + HubSpot routing rules. Tara -> prompts + checklist copy. I'll prepare the experiment brief and expected uplift math.

growth-bot: Experiment EXP-2026-059 created. Variants: V0 (control), V1 ($8 + baseline), V2 ($20 + prompt-pack). Funnels defined: signup -> credit_awarded -> first_generate -> retention_7d. Dashboard request queued (dash-2026-34).

Diego Morales: Also adding routing rule: if email_domain in enterprise_list OR estimated_team_size >= 8 -> assign lead queue "growth-sdr" and tag as higher priority.

ops-bot: Reminder: update inbound playbook with the new "plg-activated" tag and routing details.

Tara Wu: I'll mock the template cards in Figma and drop link in channel when ready.

Rina Shah: Timeline: prompts + design by Tue, tracking + routing by Wed, experiment launch Thurs. We'll watch redemption_rate, time_to_first_generate, retention_7d, webinar_attend_rate, leads_created.

Diego Morales: Sounds good. I'll run a smoke test for tracking on staging before launch.

Tara Wu: Done. Will ping for quick copy review. :star:

Rina Shah: Thanks team 5. Let's keep it high signal and fast. I'll post the brief link when it's up."
